name: Consecrated Letter

narrative.details: I was asked to bring this to your attention as soon as you returned from the kobold camps, adventurer. It appears to be a letter sealed with the insignia of Brother Sammuel, our local paladin trainer. I wouldn't hesitate to read it before you go about any other business here in the Abbey.
narrative.objectives: Read the Consecrated Letter and speak to Brother Sammuel in Northshire Abbey.
narrative.offerRewardText:
In the meantime, you should know one or two other things. You are a symbol to many here in this land--act accordingly. The Holy Light shines within you, and it will be obvious to both your allies and your enemies.

Also, as you gain in wisdom and power, you will need to train to learn new abilities. That's where I come in. When you feel you've gained some experience here in Northshire, come back to me and I will teach you what I feel you are ready to learn. Good luck... Champion!
narrative.requestItemsText: Finally! We meet face to face, brother to brother. I welcome you to Northshire. This will be your home for a short time while you learn the ins and outs of how things are done, but know that Stormwind is not far off, and sooner or later, your path will take you there. But until then, be patient... Knight of the Silver Hand.
